column4: not a helper process: the standard Go subprocess idiom, carried by two packages -- cmd/cleat-bench/main_test.go:16 and cmd/cleat-gen-plugin/main_test.go:17 -- each gating its real body on os.Getenv("GO_HELPER_PROCESS") != "1". The function IS the re-executed test binary entry point (it rewrites os.Args and calls main()), not an assertion, so outside its own subprocess invocation it has nothing to check and skips structurally and permanently -- it can never be made to run as an ordinary test. One line for both because this checker matches on the test NAME, and the name is identical in each package with no package component in the pattern to separate them. Measured: 2, in this job own CI report (runs 36960077192 / 36958306991 / 36956579623).
